note: P4395 (Pro 31:21) — she is not afraid of snow for her household; all are clothed in scarlet.

dims.v: provident security — no fear of snow, for her household is well provided

the being unafraid of snow for her household, because all are warmly clothed — the settled security that comes of provident foresight, a fearlessness born not of denial but of preparation, having provided against the hard season before it comes
(the well-provided household that grounds her calm)
the calm confidence that provident preparation gives against hard times

yare (fear), negated — 'she is not AFRAID of snow for her household, for all her household are clothed in scarlet' (31:21); her fearlessness is the fruit of foresight — she has provided against winter in advance. Provident preparation turns anxiety into calm security (cf 31:25; 6:6-8).
